title: feat(nsparinc): nspar x-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Same-tick union own lock on nspar x-probes: S^+(A) grows to {+e1,-e1} but reverse still fails because S^+(B)={+e2,+e3} contains neither; face holds. A second witness that reverse needs -L(A) present in S^+(B), not merely a mixed S^+(A).
